notes: No-arg constructor of this RuntimeException subclass. Used throughout jagdx (PixelBuffer.kt, GeometryBuffer.kt, etc.) as a generic 'invalid argument / bounds check failed' exception, e.g. `throw fda()` when a buffer write's offset/length validation fails.

Message constructor, delegates to super(message). Used pervasively across jagdx/IDirect3D*.kt wrapper classes as `throw fda(hresultValue.toString())` whenever a DirectX HRESULT indicates failure per ue.a()/ue.isFailure(). Class itself (`fda`) looks like an obfuscated leftover name -- a future pass might rename the class to something like `DirectXException` or `NativeCallException`, but class renames are out of scope for this per-method CSV.
